purpose: skeptical, independent re-derivation of the MobileNetV2 TensorRT evasion matrix from saved artifacts + forward engine inference

1_clean_reproduction.summary: population reloaded from Imagenette val (seed 20261030); fresh clean top-1 = 83/83/84/79/83 (expected 83/83/84/79/83); max |fresh clean.npz logits| = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0; 0 clean_prediction row mismatches.

2_candidate_rescoring.summary: re-scored 1860 saved candidates in 87 .pt files: 0 prediction/adv_correct/linf mismatches required; random control reconstructed (2000 forwards) with 0 mismatches; FGSM sign-structure violations = 0 pixels.

3_transfer_provenance.summary: fp32 fp32 candidates re-scored on all four non-fp32 engines and reconciled with all 3200 transfer rows; destination .pt copies are bit-identical to the fp32 source subsets.

4_aggregate_recomputation.summary: recomputed 10700 per-image rows / 107 conditions; shared set n=78; summary aggregates, matrix.json 107 per-arm cells + 32 transfer + 40 union cells, and matrix.md 107 per-arm + 32 transfer + 40 union rows all reconciled.

5_artifact_integrity.summary: all ten ONNX/engine SHA-256 values still match summary/runtime/matrix; 117 files under results/<arm>/ unchanged during verification (added=0, removed=0, changed=0).

6_headline_sanity.summary: PGD/BPDA-PGD = 100.0% on all 5 arms at 1/2/4/8/255; pgd_stronger = 100.0% (vacuous: 0 survivors everywhere); Square 4/255 = 48.2%, 30.1%, 25.0%, 19.0%, 44.6% and Square 8/255 = 85.5%, 75.9%, 54.8%, 49.4%, 85.5% (own denominator); random control max 6.0%; no counting/denominator/leak/over-epsilon/mislabeled-transfer defect found.

observations.detail: Measured effect of the saved fp32 FGSM 1/255 candidates on the deployed engine: mean max |delta logit| = 9.84, mean L2 |delta logit| = 45.44, top-1 flip = 83.0%, mean margin drop = 9.97 on clean-correct images (mean clean margin 5.19). The 1/255 budget is nominal only: this model is brittle enough that a single-step sign perturbation genuinely moves the engine logits by several units, so the 91.6% FGSM success is not a counting/scoring artifact.
matrix.json source_hashes do not match the current scripts; the scripts changed after reconciliation (informational only)

the 100-step x 5-restart "stronger survivor" check was vacuous on every arm: PGD already reached 100% at 1/255, so there were zero survivors to re-attack (additional_survivor_n == 0 everywhere, and the pgd_stronger rows/candidates are identical to pgd 1/255). This is a protocol-coverage limitation, not a numerical defect.
random-noise control is near zero overall but reaches 6.0% on fp8 at 8/255 (quantized arms are more noise-sensitive; still far below the 99-100% gradient-attack success).
FGSM success is not strictly monotone in eps for some arms (expected with per-step best retention and [0,1] clipping); this is reported as an observation, not a defect.
